brain.commentary: Risk-on regime is supportive, but conviction and composite scores are only marginally positive. BTC has the strongest relative signal, while ETH and SOL combine weak edge with elevated volatility and negative alpha. LTC is appropriately flat. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile: identical long signals with zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and no liquidity or institutional differentiation suggest fallback or low-information inputs. Maintain reduced aggregate risk and avoid treating broad altcoin longs as independent conviction.
